q1_issues.issue: (LocatedIn sk_market_1 sk_pblocks_1) places the FIRST market in the Pakistani blocks too, but the trailing PP most naturally attaches to the second conjunct alone ("a similar Russian market in Pakistani blocks"); the parse silently takes the wide-scope attachment instead of the favored reading or an Interpretation split.

q2_gaps: a bare plural count NP as the object of a preposition ("in Pakistani blocks") — the oblique-object rule covers only an article-marked witness or a bare mass/domain/proper-name constant, leaving generic kind vs. group witness undecided

whether a nationality/origin adjective modifier gets the exposure genus: breton_tapestry is listed as a case that fuses, but the three modifier types listed as exposed are gradable, positional/cardinal and material only
notes: "similar" is used attributively with its standard of comparison recovered from the first conjunct, and the Similar + (Symmetric Similar) encoding otherwise follows the stated symmetric-predicate pattern. (For sk_market_N shopping) reads as a preposition-named oblique carried on an entity, on the precedent of entity-attached (From …).
